# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game titled **House Cup Spell Trial**. Preserve a bubble-shooter mechanic exactly: the player drags to aim a bottom launcher, releases to fire a colored orb, bounces off side walls, snaps into a staggered hex grid, clears connected groups of three or more same-type orbs, drops floating clusters, earns score, loses if the stack reaches the lower danger rows, and can restart.

Reinterpret the mechanic as a Harry Potter-inspired wizard-school adventure without using protected story names in implementation-critical mechanics: the player is a first-year chosen student practicing in a cozy gothic castle hall. Colored bubbles are house spell charms with runes. Matching three is spell mastery for House Points. Dropped clusters are curse knots released from the ceiling. The bottom launcher is a wand lectern. Game over is a forbidden curse cloud reaching the corridor. The scene should show floating candles, house banners, enchanted ceiling stars, gothic arches, magical particles, and readable mobile HUD copy.

Use browser-native HTML/CSS/Canvas/JavaScript in one canonical `index.html`. Keep controls touch-friendly and optimized for portrait aspect ratios between 4:7 and 9:16. Use catalog-approved fonts and media only when media is needed; procedural visuals should own the playfield.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — House Cup Spell Trial

## Source game truth
The implemented game is a portrait-friendly canvas bubble shooter. The player starts from a menu, drags/clicks in the playfield to aim a launcher at the bottom, releases to shoot one colored orb, bounces off side walls, snaps to a hex grid when it hits the ceiling or an existing orb, clears connected groups of 3 or more matching types, drops disconnected clusters, gains score, loses when an unmatched landing reaches the lower danger rows, and restarts when the grid clears.

## Protected mechanics
- Input: drag/click/touch in playfield aims; release fires when a projectile is not already moving.
- Motion: projectile velocity is angle-based, bounces on left/right walls, and advances in the same update loop.
- Grid: 8-column staggered hex grid with odd-row offsets, top five rows initially populated.
- Collision: projectile snaps on ceiling or proximity contact with existing bubbles.
- Match scoring: connected match length >= 3 clears for 10 points each.
- Floating drop scoring: disconnected bubbles clear for 20 points each.
- Failure: non-clearing landed bubble at or below `GRID_ROWS - 2` triggers game over.
- Progress reset: empty grid starts a fresh board while preserving the same loop.

## Remixed target
The same mechanics are reframed as a wizard-school House Cup charm trial: spell orbs carry house identities, the bottom launcher is a student wand/dueling lectern, score becomes House Points, matching becomes spell mastery, floating drops become lifted curse knots, and failure is a curse cloud breaching the lower corridor.

## Safe transformation surfaces
HUD copy, title, modal text, palette, orb rendering, background, particles, audio labels, GIF feedback, UI chrome, world ribbon, and scene evolution are presentation-only and safe to transform. The implementation should remain browser-native and mobile-first.
